summary: A smaller version of {design} puts the depth of the relief in doubt.
realLife: John Saunders asked about a tenth-ounce gold issue and Mint staff and members discussed how little room it left for the program's sculptural relief.
gates: Members are considering a smaller issue of a design intended to have high relief.
inGame: needs: proposed size and relief assessment.

turns.what: The small issue gets a flatter model.
turns.pulledBy: A test strike loses the highest points.
turns.writesBack: A separate model is commissioned for that size.

turns.pulledBy: The relief is essential to the approved artwork.
turns.writesBack: Only the larger piece stays on the calendar.
